car.name: Rotarypetal 2011
car.description: Original logo-free 2994 four-seat rotary coupe with rear-hinged small rear doors. Source-backed US 2011 Sport six-speed manual specification; naturally aspirated rotary torque-curve abstraction, not a physical Wankel simulation.

catalogProvenance.inspiration: US 2011 Mazda RX-8 Sport six-speed manual LHD, not R3/automatic

sources.locator: OEM Mazda USA 2011 spec PDF inspected by researcher; Sport/manual columns

estimates: 1308cc is physical rotary chamber sum, not piston equivalence. Existing ICE torque-curve model approximates a rotary; it does NOT physically simulate Wankel combustion, seals or rotor dynamics.

OEM torque-sensing conical LSD approximated by existing rear35%accel/15%decel locking controls. These are simulation estimates, NOT measured OEM lock constants or an exact torque-bias differential simulation. No new drivetrain model claimed.

850idle,9200cutoff,350limiterdrop,torque curve away from159lb-ft5500 and232hp8500,launch/shift controls,90%efficiency,20USmpg,145mph/6.4s display values are simulation estimates; display targets are not verified performance.

32psi,CG.48m,overhang split,collider subshapes,alignment,normalized spring/damper/roll/brake/tire parameters and friction are simulation estimates. OEM laden clearance used as collider clearance approximation, not asserted unloaded clearance. No driver mass adjustment.
225/45R18 nominal unloaded radius .32985m is geometric, not loaded rolling radius. Metric conversions retain source rounding, not higher measurement precision.
